reply:
localStorage is shared across tabs of the same origin. sessionStorage is per-tab.

Your original answer stands: if you're keeping a login flag in localStorage, any tab on that origin will see it and auto-login. That's the source of the cross-tab login behavior users are reporting.

grade.note: Assistant now correctly states localStorage is shared across tabs and reworks its explanation accordingly.
